scientific_role: establish checklist completeness and effort support before any species-level annual occupancy is constructed

schema_compatibility.reason: eBird Basic Dataset metadata v1.16 renamed PROTOCOL TYPE to OBSERVATION TYPE and added PROTOCOL NAME; current official Sampling Event Data therefore must not be rejected solely because it uses the post-Feb-2025 header schema

official_semantics.ecological_use: only complete checklists may later support species nondetection; missing species rows in incomplete checklists are never absences

validation.sampling_event_identifier: nonblank and globally unique within the supplied SED extract
validation.all_species_reported: must normalize to TRUE/FALSE from true,false,1,0 only
validation.protocol_fields: blank values are counted, not silently dropped; exactly one supported protocol-header schema must be identifiable
validation.group_identifier: blank allowed; repeated nonblank groups are audited as potential duplicate-party checklists

fixed_effort_bins_for_audit_only.role: descriptive coverage bins only; they are not future survey-quality thresholds

report_only: detected SED protocol-header schema (modern v1.16+ or legacy pre-v1.16)
nonblank group-identifier frequency and repeated-group frequency
next_gate: only after this audit succeeds may a separate response-independent contract freeze checklist deduplication, effort quality rules and checklist-to-island geometry mapping; species outcomes remain closed until that second contract is frozen
anti_selection: do not choose duration, distance, observer-count or protocol thresholds from species persistence/source-loss outcomes
do not treat incomplete checklists as nondetection support
do not use Dryad observed-species rows to fill missing SED metadata
do not infer island-year occupancy in this audit
do not promote the eBird candidate because BALA was non-supportive
do not reject a current official SED solely because it uses OBSERVATION TYPE and PROTOCOL NAME rather than legacy PROTOCOL TYPE
